content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR NIO Project Associate I Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 23-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NIO to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I recruitment is 23rd August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is an MSc in Marine Biology, Zoology, Marine Science (specialization in Biology), or Oceanography (specialization in Biology).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate - I position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate - I post at CSIR NIO.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate - I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online through the official CSIR NIO website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Associate - I is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is CSIR National Institute of Oceanography located?
faq.answer: CSIR National Institute of Oceanography is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is GAP3294/3289-26.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the apply online link in the "Important Links" section of this article.
